LongMemEval official evaluator fixture

Source: https://github.com/xiaowu0162/LongMemEval/blob/9e0b455f4ef0e2ab8f2e582289761153549043fc/src/evaluation/evaluate_qa.py
Revision: 9e0b455f4ef0e2ab8f2e582289761153549043fc

This is an exact pinned source fixture for offline protocol tests. The tests
extract only get_anscheck_prompt via AST; they never import its SDK dependencies
or invoke the upstream executable. It permits running tests without cloning the
upstream repository. LF blob SHA-256:
ecce9c4c79dc89d99534ac17b383a5cbb5b9f0c69ee98adaf0684742e3d95251
The exact Windows CRLF checkout variant has SHA-256:
5085eb9ae08b91c6c4f97c6bea9b8c2d6e55f9ec72c27734cafa0a04f00a430a
